description_zh: 曼努埃尔·诺列加（1938-至今），巴拿马前总统，1983-1990年在位。他是一位巴拿马政治家，前军官，通过领导巴拿马毒品走私和美国入侵，实现了巴拿马的独立和运河主权。诺列加是独裁统治者，通过毒品走私和美国的干预，巩固了他的权力。他的统治时期，巴拿马经历了毒品走私和美国入侵，导致国内政治动荡。
description_en: Manuel Noriega (1938-present), former President of Panama, served from 1983 to 1990. He was a Panamanian politician and former military officer, led Panama's drug smuggling and US intervention to achieve Panama's independence and canal sovereignty. Noriega was a dictator, through drug smuggling and US intervention, consolidated his power. His rule period, Panama experienced drug smuggling and US invasion, leading to domestic political turmoil.
